units: <cite ref="Berakhot 61b">Ber. 61ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:9">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>מַקְהִיל קהילות ברבים</he> called public assemblies (to teach).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99:7">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> <he>כשיַקְהִיל קרח וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>כשיַקְהֵל</he>) when Korah will gather his followers for strife, my (Jacob’s) name shall not be joined with them.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 408:2">Yalk. Ex. 408</cite> <he>כדי שילמדו … להַקְהִיל וכ׳</he> that coming generations may learn from thee to assemble congregations every Sabbath; a. e.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>בשעה שהן נִקְהָלִין על וכ׳</he> when they will be assembled against Moses in the party of Korah &c.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:2">Lev. R. s. 24</cite> <he>פרשה … בהִקָּהֵל וכ׳</he> this section (<cite ref="Leviticus 19">Lev. XIX</cite>) was proclaimed in full assembly (v. ib. 2), because &c.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:1">Koh. R. to I, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00212"><he>קֹהֶלֶת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> (ref. to <he>יקהת</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:10">Gen. XLIX, 10</cite>) <he>מי … מִתְקָהֲלִין עליו</he> he around whom the nations will group themselves.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>מתקהלא</he>, v. <cite ref="S00201"><he>קָהָה</he></cite>.]
